generator: art-terrain v5 / Azure gpt-image-2 (ground edit + generated sprite sheets) + procedural overlays

layout.haloNote: single soft feathered ellipse of lighter ground about 80% of the width (rx 165, ry 107 css) centred on the tower, plus a small irregular paving patch (~62 css wide) under the tower; no rings
layout.groundBelowTower: ground runs to the bottom edge (HUD overlays it)

recommendedTowerScale.note: tower-v2 composite (pedestal + head/barrel scaled x1.35) measures 252 x 453 image px; x0.28 -> 70 x 127 css = 17% of the 412 width. Pedestal base footprint ~50 css, tower base point = pedestal anchor (160,448) of tw-ped

enemyScale.note: css per image px = 33.9 / ppu (wisp 160px frame -> 71 css, = 144 world px x 0.494)

light.rim: cool, per theme glow colour on the right/lower-right edges

shadow.note: cast shadow = silhouette flipped vertically about the root, scaleY, skewX; draw under props/tower/enemies. Ground contact shadow + AO under the tower is already baked into the ground plate (offset +5,+3 css lower-right).

vignette: a light vignette is baked into the ground; no extra needed

motion.note: draw behind the ground; no rotation of the bitmap, drift + subtle brightness pulse
